blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The prosecution of the International Criminal Court (ICC) is banking on a report by an “expert” and prerecorded testimonies of three additional witnesses to help build the evidence in the trial for crimes against humanity against former President Rodrigo Duterte. In a filing on Oct. 21 made public on Saturday, the prosecutors are asking the Trial Chamber (TC) III to admit as evidence the reports and other associated materials provided by a witness identified only as “P-1400” who is an “expert.” They said the testimony and report provided would be of assistance to the chamber and would help […]...
